title: US single release: Maybe I’m Amazed by Wings | 1977
content:
Wings’ single ‘Maybe I’m Amazed’ was released in the USA on 28 January 1977.

‘Maybe I’m Amazed’ had been a track on Paul McCartney’s début solo album McCartney. Six years later, a live version was issued from the 1976 album Wings Over America and became an international hit.

Sometimes we’re a bit daft here. We have a bit of a funky organisation, you know, which isn’t that clued into picking tracks off albums. At the time we thought ‘Maybe I’m Amazed’ was a good track and maybe we should do that as a single, which it probably should have been. But we never did.
Paul McCartney

The single reached number 10 on the Billboard Hot 100 in America. The b-side of the single was ‘Soily’, also from Wings Over America.

It was released on 4 February 1977 in the UK, where it peaked at number 28, spending just two weeks in the top 30.
